lines.beaver: 김만덕 자료를 찾는데 신상 기록이 별로 없네요.
lines.beaver_en: I'm looking into Kim Man-deok, but there aren't many personal records.
lines.beaver_roman: Gimmandeok jaryoreul channeunde sinsang girogi byeollo eomneyo.
lines.learner: 기록은 적어도 제주 사람인 건 확실해요.
lines.en: Records are few, but she was definitely from Jeju.
lines.roman: Girogeun jeogeodo jeju saramin geon hwaksilhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are records of her birth and death years left?
lines.en: Born in 1739, she lived to 73, so she lived long.

lines.beaver_en: In Jeju back then, she must have been close to the oldest.
lines.learner: 최고령은 아니어도 꽤 나이 많은 편이었을 거예요.
lines.en: Maybe not the oldest, but she was probably fairly old.
lines.roman: Choegoryeongeun anieodo kkwae nai maneun pyeonieosseul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 어릴 때 부모를 잃고 기녀가 됐다던데요.
lines.beaver_en: I heard she lost her parents young and became a gisaeng.
lines.beaver_roman: Eoril ttae bumoreul ilko ginyeoga dwaetdadeondeyo.
lines.learner: 가난했어도 꿈을 쉽게 버리지 않았나 봐요.
lines.en: Though poor, she seems not to have given up her dreams.
lines.roman: Gananhaesseodo kkumeul swipge beoriji ananna bwayo.

lines.beaver: 나중엔 큰 상인이 돼서 돈을 많이 벌었대요.
lines.beaver_en: Later she became a big merchant and earned a lot.
lines.beaver_roman: Najungen keun sangini dwaeseo doneul mani beoreotdaeyo.
lines.en: I think she lived simply even though she was rich.

lines.beaver: 흉년에 전 재산으로 쌀을 사서 나눴다고 해요.
lines.beaver_en: In a famine, she used her whole fortune to buy and share rice.
lines.beaver_roman: Hyungnyeone jeon jaesaneuro ssareul saseo nanwotdago haeyo.
lines.learner: 돈만 아는 사람이었다면 선뜻 못 했겠죠.
lines.en: Someone who only cared about money couldn't have done that so readily.
lines.roman: Donman aneun saramieotdamyeon seontteut mot taetgetjyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do later generations judge her? All positive?
lines.en: Mostly good, but some analyses say it's exaggerated.

lines.beaver_en: For a woman then, it must have been a rare life.
lines.learner: 그 시대 여성상과는 많이 달랐을 거예요.
lines.en: She was probably very different from that era's ideal woman.
lines.roman: Geu sidae yeoseongsanggwaneun mani dallasseul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did she manage all of that alone?
lines.en: She might have teamed up with other merchants.

lines.beaver: 좋아요, 그 짐작들도 발표 자료에 넣을게요.
lines.beaver_en: Great, I'll add those guesses to the presentation.
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo, geu jimjakdeuldo balpyo jaryoe neoeulgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 출처는 꼭 따로 표시해 주세요.
lines.en: Okay, just be sure to mark the sources separately.
lines.roman: Ne, chulcheoneun kkok ttaro pyosihae juseyo.
